name: project
description: Superpowers extension for durable project setup, GitHub issues and milestones, native user-input grilling, goal-backed execution, and worker-thread orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Project setup, GitHub issues, milestones, goal-backed execution, and orchestration for Superpowers.
interface.longDescription: Superpowers Project extends Superpowers with large-scope project setup, roadmap and milestone mapping, GitHub issue mirrors, issue triage, native request_user_input grilling, native /goal-backed issue resolution, and optional worker-thread orchestration.
defaultPrompt: Use project:initiate-workflow to choose the next Superpowers Project route.
Use project:setup-project to set up this repo's project context and tracker.
Use project:audit-project to audit Superpowers Project workflow drift.
Use project:brainstorm-spec to brainstorm a project idea with native grilling.
Use project:create-issues to convert a plan into GitHub issue mirrors.
Use project:write-plan to write the project implementation plan.
Use project:implement-plan to implement an approved plan on a development branch without creating issue mirrors.
Use project:resolve-issue to resolve one GitHub issue directly with a native goal.
Use project:orchestrate-issues to delegate issue work to a worker worktree thread.
Use project:merge-changes to merge PR-ready issue or branch work.
